scalars.scalar_value: Experience providing excellent customer service. One (1) or more years of experience working in a customer service environment Experience answering and redirecting phone calls.

items.item_text: Experience providing excellent customer service. One (1) or more years of experience working in a customer service environment Experience answering and redirecting phone calls.
Answers all incoming calls in a timely manner.
Assists callers by answering questions and connecting them to relevant resources within the Colleges.
References in real time a variety of campus resources to assist callers such as, but not limited to, campus websites, maps, directories, or calendars.
Upon request, maintains a data log of all incoming calls and make appropriate changes in campus directories as necessary.

Willing to work rotating shifts with appropriate notice, which may include days, nights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates may occasionally be required to cover shifts on short notice in the event of unforeseen circumstances.
Effectively communicates and collaborates in a high-performance team environment.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
